name: Night strands
summary: Everyone's stories from one night drawn left to right by time as one coloured strand per friend with each story a bead; strands braid where friends were in the same place and split where they weren't, and tapping a bead opens that moment to heart it.
useWhen: everyone posted stories saturday, make the night into one thing
show where we all were last night and when we were together
recap of the night from the six's stories
who was where on friday, golden lantern then the anchor
turn last night's stories into a timeline we can heart
dontUseWhen: a recap of a whole trip or semester (use trip-story or semester-wrapped)
checking everyone got home safe (send a direct message)

stories.description: Every story from the night: who posted it, the time like '8:15pm', the place, and the caption in their words

hearts.description: Hearts already given: the 0-based index of the story and the names who hearted it
